notes: Epic order follows spec §13. E05-E10 can run in parallel once their dependencies are done, subject to write-scope conflicts. Tasks are created per epic by the architect skill.

Sprint 1 parallelism: T002, T003, T004, T005 write disjoint files and may run together. T002 owns tests/test_inventory.py. T006, T007, T008 may run together (per-library outputs; overrides are per-item files).
T010 dependency relaxed from T009 to T002/T003/T014 by the coordinator: the schema needs the finished inventory, not the audit report; T009 is read-only so they run in parallel.
Sprint 2: T015 installs every npm dependency so parallel tasks never touch package.json. T016+T017 parallel; T018+T019 parallel; T020 then T021 (coordinator pushes and checks the live deploy).

E04 parallelism: after T021, T022 (content/), T023 (views/RadialTree + layout script), T025 (cutscenes/) run together; T024 after T023; T026 after T022. T023 and T024 both touch the tree view - sequential.

Design review round 1 (2026-10-24, docs/BRIEF_DESIGN_REVIEW_1.md): order E12 -> E11 -> E08 -> E05 (by stage, user review between stages) -> E06, E09, E07, E10. E05 starts only after E11's taxonomy and validator are merged.

Sprint 3 parallelism: wave 1 T028, T031, T032 (E12) plus T034 (E11, new files only) run together. Then T029+T030 (after T028), T036+T037 (after T034). T035 after T029. T038 -> T039 -> T040 sequential (tree view).

E01.title: Inventory and source extraction
E01.goal: List every Wave 1 catalogue item and extract signature, parameters (defaults, allowed values), attributes, methods, documented library version and source URL from official docs. Pin one version per library.

E02.title: Content schema
E02.goal: Define the record form per archetype from the 11 slots, plus metadata fields and relationship fields. Relationships and validation inputs derive from schema fields. Includes schema validation tooling.

E03.title: App foundation and Observatory design system
E03.goal: Static React PWA scaffold, colour and type tokens (light/dark, token-swappable modes), fonts, shadcn/ui restyle, desktop layout shell with panel and bottom sheet, 11-slot item page renderer, code blocks, data-frame diff style, auto-deploy to a free static host.

E04.title: First slice: Model › Boosting end to end
E04.goal: GradientBoosting, HistGradientBoosting, XGBoost and LightGBM: schema filled, radial tree, one cutscene, relationship lines, a short journey and notebook output. Proves every system early.

E12.title: Review fixes and the What comes out slot
E12.goal: F3-F10 from design review round 1, the 12th slot 'What comes out' (A4: schema, renderer, content for the 4 boosting and 4 hyperparameter pages), typography (A8), badges (A9), key settings wording (A10).

E11.title: Taxonomy and Questions mode
E11.goal: content/taxonomy.yaml from docs/QUESTION_MAP.md, taxonomy validator, record migration to taxonomy family ids, per-goal stored layouts with the A5 fan, goal selector (A1), Names/Questions label toggle (A3), search on both label sets, the we_need_but stem. Fixes F1, F2.

E08.title: Pipeline builder and route map
E08.goal: A flat route map replaces the globe journey (spec 7.3, A6): passport chips, empty start plus 'Try a sample route', stops and alternatives per stage from taxonomy families, data-shape band, live validation with one-tap fixes, 'Add to route' on pages and Questions-mode page nodes, 'Get notebook' never disabled (A7). The four behaviour examples pass as tests. Globe code removed only after the user's review.

E05.title: Content fill by stage
E05.goal: Orchestrated parallel drafting of all Wave 1 pages from E01 extractions, stage by stage, with the reviewed flag and user batch review per stage. Drafted pages use taxonomy placement (content/taxonomy.yaml) and include the What comes out slot.

E06.title: Lookup: relationship lines, semantic zoom and search polish
E06.goal: Relationship lines on demand (including we_need_but questions to their answers), semantic zoom and search polish. The question door moved to E11.

E09.title: Cutscenes and toy data
E09.goal: Shared toy datasets (Ames, breast cancer, airline passengers), an archetype-specific hero cutscene for each archetype, and Watch-it-work slider examples, all following the motion rules. The hyperparameter archetype hero moved to E12 (F3).

E07.title: Constellation view
E07.goal: Fixed-position star map with stage clusters, pipeline path, semantic zoom, and relationship / focus / scope filters that dim and never move.

E10.title: Accessibility settings and hardening
E10.goal: Font choice incl. dyslexia option, text size and line spacing settings, full keyboard navigation of all views, screen-reader labels on canvas nodes, reduced motion everywhere, WCAG AA contrast verification of every token pair.
